_comment: AnimObject Swapper (AOS, D-7) VISIBLE test. Swaps the tavern drinking tankard (AnimObjectTankard 0x097274) for a bucket (AnimObjectBucket 0x0B18F0) -> NPCs drinking in any tavern hold a BUCKET instead of a mug. Unmistakable and harmless. Swaps the held prop, not the animation. Requires AnimObjectSwapper.dll. Both ANIO verified against Skyrim.esm via `find`. FormID~plugin form (no editorID-cache dependency).

entries._comment: Anyone doing a drink idle holds a bucket instead of the tankard.
